hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Lead-Lag Return Spillover with Volume Confirmation (pv13 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Information propagates gradually along the economic supply chain. Negating customer return signal over a 10-day decay captures mean-reverting supplier inventory adjustments. Coupling with an additive 20-day trading volume participation overlay confirms institutional accumulation. Completely decorrelated from existing portfolio (0 supply chain alphas on the account).
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during supply chain disruption where customer and supplier decouple completely.

hypotheses.title: Corporate News Sentiment Drift with Institutional Participation (nws12 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures post-news drift and institutional reaction to corporate news articles via vec_avg(nws12_afterhsz_sl) smoothed over a 5-day linear decay. The additive volume overlay provides liquidity confirmation, eliminating short-term price delta correlation while capturing non-linear news drift across subindustries.
confounders: Sparse news coverage during holiday trading periods
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during market regimes dominated entirely by macro geopolitical headlines where corporate news is ignored.

hypotheses.title: Variance Risk Premium Spread with Volume Participation (option8 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits the structural Variance Risk Premium: institutional put insurance demand persistently prices 30-day implied volatility above 30-day realized historical volatility. Using the additive spread historical_volatility_30 - implied_volatility_mean_30 rather than call ratios eliminates collinearity with existing options alphas. Pairing with volume overlay ensures low self-correlation (< 0.50).
confounders: Black swan tail events where realized volatility surges beyond option pricing
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during severe macro volatility spikes where implied volatility lags sudden market gaps.
